NOW, THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED, and it is hereby resolved that the Mayor and Town Council adopt the following uniform requirements for the critical, emergency situation of the Town's water supply and for the health and safety of the Town water users:

No outside watering of any kind, including street flushing, public fountains, park irrigation, watering lawns, gardens shrubbery, etc.

No commercial and home Laundry use except during the hours of 7:00 P K to 7:00 A M.

The Town of Pine Mountain, Georgia recovers water from a spring on Pine Mountain and has a gravity flow system. The spring produces 73,000,000 galions annually and 40,372,000 gallons were sold from July 1, 1985 to June 30, 1986. The budget for the operation of the water end sewerage department FY 86/8? is $120,500.00.

In order to conserve water, the Town of Pine Mountain agrees that:

- 1. All water will be metered at the spring.

- 2. All service connections will be metered.

- 3. There will be a distribution map and it will be kept updated when replacements, additions and improvements are made.

- 4. A leak detection program wlll be instigated with the goal of accounting for 90% of the water produced.

- 5. A list will be prepared of ali major users and the amount of water they use per day, month or year.

- 6. A plumbing code ordinance will be established which will include control of cross-conunections and/or inter-connections. The Town of Pine Mountain will comply with the Georgia Water Conservation Act of 1977.

- 7. An ordinance wlll be passed providing for the priority use of water and the curtailment cf water use during emergencies and to assume the authority to impose penalties for noncompliance.

- 8. A realistic pricing schedule wili be adopted which will increase rates with increased usage. Fiat rate pricing will be eliminated.

- 3. Public education programs will be instigated and a home water conservation pamphiet will be published.

- 10. Monthly records will he kept to help detect water availability problens.

IMPLEMENTATION . The Town of Pine Mountain installed @ meter at the spring in early 1986. The churches are the only service connections which are not metered. These connections will be metered by the end of 1986. There is a distribution map and every effort will be made to keep it updated. fhe Town enacted a plumbing code many years age, and there are not any cross-connections or interconnections. The water rates were raised at the beginning of FY 85/86 for the first time since 1962. The water rates were increased by fifty per cent. However, the rate schedule is a fixed rate schedule. A means of eliminating this fixed rate scheduling will be discussed. A pamphlet with hints for the conservation of water at the home Level is in the process of being published at this time.

WHEREAS, the Town of Pine Mountain, Georgia owns and operates a water and sewer system, and

WHEREAS, it is essential for the public welfare to maintain and Operate the system on a sound basis, and

WHEREAS, it is in the best interest of the Town to provide ample water supply, fire protection and sewer facilities for the citizens, and

WHEREAS, in order to provide sewer service to an unserved area it has become apparent that certain portions of the sewer system must be upgraded and extended, and

WHEREAS, the Town of Pine Mountain does not have the capital resources to construct such 3 project, and

WHEREAS, it is the desire of the governing body of the Town of Pine Mountain to submit an application to the appropriate agency for consideration of funding for the proposed project.

NOW THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED by the Mayor and Council of the Town of Pine Mountain to prepare the necessary documents for submittal of an application to the Georgia Department of Community Affairs COBG program for consideration of funding the proposed improvements to the Town of Pine Mountain sewer systen.

BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that the Town of Pine Mountain will commit a sum of $10,000.00 for the required match and an additional sum of $7,250.00 as leverage for the mush needed systen.

AND BE If FURTHER RESOLVED TO AUTHORIZE THE Honorable James V Edgar, Mayor and Barbara Ewell, Town Clerk, to sign said application on behalf of the governing body.

This resolution read and passed by a quorum this 11th day of January, 1988.

I, Barbara Ewell, Town Clerk of the Town of Pine Mountain, and official keeper of the records of the Town, do hereby certify that the foregoing Resolution has been officially adopted in the Council Session and has not been rescinded in any manner.
